description.narrative: Costa Rica shows a mixed performance in productive integration and human capital. Only 61% of manufacturing inputs are domestically produced, indicating limited local value chains despite a strong export-oriented sector. Human capital indicators are solid, but labor outcomes lag, with just 49% skilled workers and high unemployment. Project Outcomes: The most significant expected project level outcomes are increased formal employment and foreign exchange generation in Costa Rica, through the construction of a greenfield manufacturing facility. Market Outcomes: Beyond direct project outcomes, IFC anticipates that its financing will strengthen market competitiveness in Costa Ricas med-tech sector through demonstration and replication effects. By enabling domestic production at scale of an advanced drug-delivery medical device integrating disposability with embedded electronics, an activity not currently undertaken at scale in the country, the Project is expected to catalyze supplier upgrading, skills spillovers, and deeper local linkages, supporting the gradual transition of Costa Ricas med-tech ecosystem toward higher-value and more technologically complex manufacturing.

Insulet Corporation (Insulet or the Company) is a MedTech company specializing in diabetes management solutions. The Company is planning to establish its first manufacturing facility in Latin America, dedicated to the production of its flagship product, the Omnipod insulin management system, a tubeless insulin delivery device for people living with diabetes (the Project). The new manufacturing facility will be located within Savia Sur, a light industrial park in Heredia, Costa Rica, developed by Portafolio Inmobiliario (Portafolio or the Developer). The proposed IFC investment consist of a US$97 million A Loan, to support the construction of the facility's coldshell. The Borrower will be 3-101-939148 SA (Savia SPV), a special purpose vehicle responsible for managing the assets of the industrial park where the plant will be located.
